corrections.reason: The Ge'ez demonstrative pronoun 'ዝ' (from 'ወእምዝ' in L02, glossed by 'ሲናገረው የመጣው ነው') was misread as 'ገ' plus a Latin 'l' due to the two vertical strokes of 'ዝ'.
The word printed is 'ሺህ' (one thousand small thorns, paired with 'ሰብዓ ታላላቅ የብረት እሾህ' = seventy large iron thorns in Dersana Medhane Alem). The bottom-right leg of 'ሺ' was misread as 'ሾ'.
The standard Andemta question formula 'እንደምን ነው አይጣላም ቢሉ' (How is it? Do they not contradict?) is clearly printed as 'እንደምን', not 'አንድምን'.
Joining across the line wrap with L38 ('ህ አለ') forms 'እንዲህ አለ' (said thus). The 3rd-order Fidel 'ዲ' with its bottom-right serif is visible at the end of L37.
As in L30, the printed word is 'እንደምን' ('እንደምን ነው አይጣላም ቢሉ').
Both legs of the 1st-order 'በ' in 'ጸበኛህን' (your enemy, matching 'ጸበኛ' in L16) are of equal length on the page image.
